messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Canary /prompt-route-v6 (new endpoint) showing 5xx rate 18% over 3m, latency p99 up 4x. Severity: P1. Paging oncall: @sam. Details: region=us-west-2, deployment=canary-42, FF=prompt_v6_route. :warning:
sam: On it. Looking at canary pods and logs. Acknowledge.
sam: quick check — traces show requests hitting the new routing shim then TLS handshake errors from runtime kernel mismatch. Reproducing 1/3 requests locally against canary instance.
kai: @sam do we need an instant rollback or killswitch? If FF flip is faster, do that first.
sam: agreed. Flipping feature flag to block new endpoint for all traffic. Command: curl -X POST https://ff.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"prompt_v6_route","action":"disable","scope":"global"}' && echo "ok"
deploy-bot: Feature flag prompt_v6_route disabled by sam via api (request id: req-9b2f). Propagation started. :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: @sam acknowledged the page. Please update on handoff.
olivia: CS note — ticketing: 12 customers experienced transient errors in last 10m, 2 enterprise tenants impacted (acct-42, acct-77). Starting customer notifications and triage.
support-lead: looping in acct-eng for acct-42 and acct-77, adding incident channel to bridge.
sam: traffic is routing back to stable route. 5xx rate dropping to baseline on canary, latency normalizing. Monitoring for ripple. :thumbsup:
kai: good. Did the canary deploy itself partially rollback? Or was it purely FF cut?
sam: FF flip stopped new endpoint. No rollback of code. Canaries still deployed but not receiving traffic.
olivia: CS: sending initial outbound to affected customers: subject "Transient errors observed — mitigation in place". Ask if they saw data loss; none reported so far.
kai: collecting logs for postmortem: kernel mismatch on new shim. I'll grab stack traces and kernel version matrix. Tagging follow-ups: revert shim changes on next infra patch, add automated kernel-compat check to rollout gating.
sam: handing over to @kai for night coverage at 12:10 PST. I'll remain reachable for 30m.
oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: from sam -> kai at 1719078340.
sam: quick retrospective notes in thread: cause likely incompatible runtime kernel selection for canary pool combined with routing using new endpoint. Mitigation: FF kill-switch. Customer impact: limited, CS outreach started. Next steps: postmortem runbook, add canary kernel sanity checks, preflight FF toggle in staging.
kai: taking over. I'll keep monitoring for 1h, then open a postmortem ticket with timeline and RCA.
sam: closing action — monitoring stable for 10m then move to resolved. :white_check_mark:
